items.title: David Spinozza interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, NY, September 27, 2025
items.q: the first time I played Saturday Night Live I was working with Carly Simon. I was her musical director for about 2-1/2, 3 years.

ctx.x: They’re just singing with tracks but they’re not really – no they’re singing but they’re singing to tracks. Did that occur when you were on the band or was that later on?

That didn’t occur when I was on the band but when I did, the first time I did – now here’s an interesting story: the first time I played Saturday Night Live I was working with Carly Simon. I was her musical director for about 2-1/2, 3 years. And she was going to be on the show singing “You’re So Vain.” And she has a little stage fright thing that kicks in every now and then so she didn’t want to do it live. So we actually recorded it at the noon show. And this was in the ‘70s. And they recorded her thing so they…
Being a musical director, did you know what the term meant?
